Regulation: B.C. Reg. 152/2026
Made under: Health Professions And Occupations Act
Published in: No. 15 – B.C. Regs. 149 to 152, August 25, including August 11, 2026
Deposit date: August 24, 2026

B.C. Reg. 152/2026, deposited August 24, 2026, under theHEALTH PROFESSIONS AND OCCUPATIONS ACT[section 27]. Ministerial Order M316/2026, dated August 20, 2026. I, Ravi Kahlon, Minister of Health, order that the Nurses and Midwives Regulation, B.C. Reg. 133/2025, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — R. KAHLON,Minister of Health. 1	Section 59 of the Nurses and Midwives Regulation, B.C. Reg. 133/2025, is repealed and the following substituted: List of full restricted activities 59A midwife may perform the restricted activities described in the following items of the Restricted Activities Table: (a)	item 28[apply ultrasound for diagnostic or imaging purposes]; (b)	item 37[authorizations to apply ultrasound]. 2	Sections 60 (g) and 67 are repealed. 3	The table to Appendix 1 is amended by adding the following items as indicated: Progesterone receptormodulators First trimester medical abortion Management of early pregnancy loss First trimester medical abortion Management of early pregnancy loss Index Page|Previous Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: BC midwives can now perform ultrasounds and prescribe abortion medications
minutes_briefs.summary: BC has amended the Nurses and Midwives Regulation to expand what midwives are allowed to do. Midwives can now apply ultrasound for diagnostic or imaging purposes, and they can prescribe progesterone receptor modulators (drugs used for first trimester medical abortion and for managing early pregnancy loss). The change was made by ministerial order M316/2026 under the Health Professions and Occupations Act and deposited as B.C. Reg. 152/2026 on August 24, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you run a clinic that employs midwives, update your policies, equipment access, and prescribing records to reflect their new ultrasound and medication authority.
